limitations: Original campaign stopped before all planned matrix calls completed. Missing outcomes are explicit.
Synthetic dependent seed/position/profile/output contrasts, not independent production attacks.
Original policy semantics are not the workbench admission presets.
Representation annotations were authored after observations, not independent blinded ground truth.
Historical spending is not added again to the current account ledger.
